ad: In a dorm room, two young men sit on a bed, shirtless, with a bag of chips beside them. One of the men, who has a tattoo of a lion and a crown on his shoulder, talks animatedly to the camera while eating a chip. He gestures with his hands, emphasizing his words, and occasionally shows a close-up of the chip. The atmosphere is relaxed and informal as they discuss the number of chips they have eaten.
